objective: Close R1B1 by classifying every required R1B feature family according to exact historical pregame source custody and semantic parity. No analogous feature, zero-fill, current-only payload, outcome-reading replay, or post-hoc history restriction may be promoted to exact parity.

classificationPolicy.PARITY_CERTIFIED: Exact current family semantics are reproducible historically for the intended evaluation universe with immutable pregame custody, required identity/timestamp provenance, no outcome fields, and no market-price fields.
classificationPolicy.PARTIAL_PARITY: A valid pregame source, exact builder semantics, or upstream equivalent evidence exists, but full-universe coverage and/or exact current-family adapter parity is not yet proven.
classificationPolicy.BLOCKED: Exact current-family historical pregame semantics cannot presently be certified without an unsupported substitution or missing source custody.

evidence: R1B located an immutable historical V16 artifact only as a pure-settlement-model manifest, not a per-game/per-side pregame sporting probability rowset under current R1A semantics.
requiredFamilies.requiredUnblock: Identify or materialize immutable pregame V16 probabilities by officialDate/gamePk/side/stage with no outcome or price fields.

evidence: The located historical Daily Best Pick replay imports a parent scorer carrying outcomes.
Existing certification states production prepriceRank is not reconstructed exactly.
requiredFamilies.requiredUnblock: Produce an outcome-blind adapter from frozen pregame inputs that emits exact A+/Premium evidence and source preprice rank before settlement.

evidence: Pregame starter-quality custody exists in prior V62/V66 evidence.

Current certified STATCAST_QUALITY is produced from Baseball Savant current-season expected_statistics and statcast pitcher leaderboards, including ERA/xERA gap, xwOBA gap, HardHit% and Barrel% before conversion to runsDelta.
V66 starter-quality custody instead standardizes pitch-level velocity, spin, whiff, strike and hard-contact components; it is upstream quality evidence but not the same current runsDelta semantics.
No immutable target-date historical Savant leaderboard snapshots covering the intended 2022-2026_YTD universe have yet been proven.
requiredFamilies.requiredUnblock: Identify immutable pregame target-date Savant expected-statistics/statcast snapshots and reproduce the current certified evaluatePitcher runsDelta path exactly, including provenance and fail-closed behavior.

evidence: No immutable full-history normalized pregame pack under current homeRunsDelta/awayRunsDelta semantics has been proven.
requiredFamilies.requiredUnblock: Identify or materialize exact historical DISCIPLINE_SPEED inputs with immutable source timestamps and provenance.

evidence: No immutable full-history normalized pregame pack under current adjustedRpgDelta semantics has been proven.
requiredFamilies.requiredUnblock: Identify or materialize exact historical SOS component with strictly prior-date opponent-strength custody.

evidence: No immutable full-history normalized pregame pack under current totalAdjustment semantics has been proven.
Non-overlap with the other matchup-family adapters has not yet been proven.
requiredFamilies.requiredUnblock: Identify or materialize exact historical ADVANCED_CONTEXT and prove temporal custody and non-duplication.

evidence: P0 Step12V66 contains verified pre-outcome bullpen workload/source custody across 2022-2026_YTD, including recent bullpen pitches and reliever identities.

Current certified bullpen evidence is produced through createMlbUnifiedV16CertifiedBullpenProvider -> getBullpenStatus and requires target-time active roster, season pitching evidence used for reliever-role classification, and complete recent-game usage feeds before runsAdjustment is certified.
The inspected V66 custody does not establish immutable target-time active-roster snapshots or the complete season-stat role evidence required to reproduce current getBullpenStatus semantics exactly.
Therefore V66 workload custody alone cannot be promoted to current homeBullpen.runsAdjustment/awayBullpen.runsAdjustment parity.
requiredFamilies.requiredUnblock: Prove immutable target-date active-roster and season-stat role custody across the intended universe, combine it with the certified recent-usage history, and reproduce current getBullpenStatus/runsAdjustment exactly including no-history and fail-closed dispositions.

evidence: Frozen builder semantics are historically reconstructable pregame with target-date exclusion and no same-date outcome leakage.
Successful workflow run 31666803576 pins immutable hand-split source packs for 2024, 2025 and 2026_YTD.
No equivalent 2022 or 2023 hand-split artifact is present in that successful run, so the intended 2022-2026_YTD universe remains incomplete.
requiredFamilies.requiredUnblock: Pin equivalent immutable 2022 and 2023 pregame source packs and reproduce the frozen hand-split builder under identical target-date exclusion semantics.

evidence: Frozen pitchmix builder semantics are historically reconstructable pregame under the 365-day exclusive-target-date rule and frozen coverage thresholds.
Successful workflow run 31669146698 pins immutable pitchmix source packs for 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026_YTD.
No equivalent 2022 pitchmix artifact is present in that successful run, so the intended 2022-2026_YTD universe remains incomplete.
requiredFamilies.requiredUnblock: Pin an equivalent immutable 2022 pregame source pack and reproduce the frozen pitchmix builder under the identical 365-day exclusive-target-date and coverage semantics.

closureDecision.meaning: R1B1 itself is complete as an audit. R1B historical materialization remains scientifically blocked because zero of nine required families currently meet full exact historical parity for the intended universe.
